name: zgeometry_model_add_point_list_polygon_to_di
description: zGeometry_Model::AddPointListPolygonToDi validates point count, builds UVs when the source polygon has a UV basis, forwards material/flags/userTag to zDi::AddPolygon, and frees temporary UVs.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the invalid count and UV-backed material path; random debug-material fallback is covered by the accepted FindOrCreateRandomDebugMaterial target.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ba90 validates the pointCount < 3 error return, UV-basis branch, BuildPolygonUvList call, source material selection, debug material fallback, zDi::AddPolygon forwarding, optional UV free, and return value.
The native model UV/DI smoke verifies invalid count returns -1 and a UV-backed point-list polygon creates one display-instance polygon with the expected material and vertex count.
